Route8_Text_AidanIntro: You look good at POKéMON, but how is your chemistry grade?
Route8_Text_AidanPostBattle: I am better at school than this!
Route8_Text_StanIntro: All right! Let's play a game!
Route8_Text_GlennIntro: You should be informed. You need strategy to win at this!
Route8_Text_PaigeIntro: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!
Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle: When POKéMON grow up, they get ugly! They shouldn't evolve.
Route8_Text_LeslieIntro: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.
Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat: You made it clear to me that I should stick with school.
Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle:
I was planning on getting some fresh air for a change, but…
We're stuck here because of the gates at SAFFRON.
Route8_Text_AndreaIntro: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow, meow!
Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are cute, too!
Route8_Text_MeganIntro: We must look silly standing here like this.
Route8_Text_MeganDefeat: Look what you did to my poor, cute POKéMON!
Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle:
SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us go through.
I know he's doing his job, but I think he's mean.
Route8_Text_RichPostBattle: Playing games and POKéMON are like eating peanuts! I just can't stop!
Route8_Text_JuliaIntro: What's a cute, round, and fluffy POKéMON?
Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat:
Stop!
Don't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!
Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle:
I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when it's exposed to a MOON STONE.
I read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL. I wonder if it's true?
Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign: UNDERGROUND PATH CELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
Route8_Text_EliIntro: ELI: Twin power is fantastic. Did you know?
Route8_Text_EliDefeat: ELI: But… We used our twin power…
Route8_Text_EliPostBattle: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with ANNE!
Route8_Text_EliNotEnoughMons: ELI: We can't battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
Route8_Text_AnneIntro: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin power!
Route8_Text_AnnePostBattle: ANNE: I'm raising POKéMON with ELI.
Route8_Text_AnneNotEnoughMons: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle! But bring two POKéMON.
Route8_Text_RicardoDefeat: Aww, man. I'm not into this.
Route8_Text_RicardoPostBattle: I got grass caught up in my spokes, man.
Route8_Text_JarenIntro: Clear the way, or I'll run you down!
Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle: Don't think you're all special and all just because of this.
